name: jevreel
description: Search and understand videos without embeddings: contact sheets plus Jev typed decisions, as MCP tools and a skill.

interface.shortDescription: Search and understand videos without embeddings
interface.longDescription: Find moments, people, objects and on-screen text in a video file or URL. Jev screens every second on contact sheets, re-checks the best windows on full frames, and hands you the frames to look at. Needs FFmpeg, uv and a TypeSafe API key saved once with `uvx --from "jevreel[url]==0.2.0" jevreel login`.
defaultPrompt: Use jevreel to find when the speaker shows a bar chart in talk.mp4.
Use jevreel to find every moment the person in photo.jpg appears in this video.
